description: This file is a shell script used for managing Google Test (gtest) applications, including downloading, cleaning, and handling gtest app packages based on a JSON manifest and command-line parameters.

methods.name: echo_t
methods.description: A helper function to log timestamped messages to the log file.

methods.name: clean_gtest_app
methods.description: Removes the specified gtest application directory and unmounts associated resources.

methods.name: download_all_gtest_apps
methods.description: Downloads all gtest applications listed in the rdm-manifest.json file, removing existing ones if necessary.
